fact: Decreto-lei n.º 47/2022 (Boletim Oficial n.º 111, 24 November 2022) makes a binding prior opinion from the DNME compulsory before ICT purchases of 2,000,000 escudos or more by direct and indirect State administration, verifying alignment with the ICT architecture, norms and reference guidelines of the public administration, and requires reuse of the PDEX interoperability platform.
title: Boletim Oficial n.º 111, I Série, 24 de novembro de 2022 (Decreto-lei n.º 47/2022)
publisher: Boletim Oficial da República de Cabo Verde
